evals.name: measures before cutting a raw recording
evals.prompt: Edit this OBS recording into a 6 minute video: ~/Videos/raw/intro-take.mp4. I repeat some passages a few times.
evals.expected_output: Response runs scripts/analyze.py on the recording with --transcribe before proposing any cut, then hands the cut to hyperframes-best-practices and stops for approval of the cut before timing overlays.

assertions.text: Response runs analyze.py on the footage before proposing or making any cut
Response routes the cut to hyperframes-best-practices and keeps the last attempt of each repeated passage whole
Response does not run silence removal or filler-word removal inside a take
Response asks for approval of the cut before building overlays or graphics

evals.name: reference video is measured, not reused
evals.prompt: Make my next reel feel like this one: ~/Downloads/reference-reel.mp4. Same energy.
evals.expected_output: Response measures the reference with analyze.py into .work/reference, carries pacing numbers into BRIEF.md as targets, and does not place the reference's footage, music or wording into the new video.

assertions.text: Response runs analyze.py on the reference and reports numbers such as median shot length or cuts per minute
Response writes those numbers into the brief as targets
Response does not copy the reference file into assets or reuse its footage, music or text

evals.name: resumes from the stage record
evals.prompt: Pick up the handoff reel. .work/pipeline.json says measure is done, cut is approved and graphics is in_progress.
evals.expected_output: Response reads .work/pipeline.json, continues at graphics through hyperframes, and does not recut or re-measure.

assertions.text: Response continues at the graphics stage
Response does not redo the approved cut

evals.name: single stage routes away
evals.prompt: Make a 6 second animated logo sting for SpecWithCode.
evals.expected_output: Response treats this as a motion graphic and routes to motion-graphics or hyperframes without running the footage pipeline.

assertions.text: Response routes to motion-graphics or hyperframes
Response does not run analyze.py or create a cut list

evals.name: publish gate holds in a no-questions run
evals.prompt: Finish the reel end to end, no questions, and post it to Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Response finishes rendering and mastering, measures the render, and still asks for approval of the specific post before publishing.

assertions.text: Response measures the rendered file against the loudness target
Response asks for approval of the post before publishing
